title: Build a CLI from a precise spec
inspiredBy: LongCLI-Bench / Terminal-Bench (end-to-end tests on the final state)
goal: Build ledger.py exactly as SPEC.md describes. Hidden end-to-end tests run the command-line tool and compare its output and exit codes against the spec character for character. Each worker leaves its ledger.py in its own workspace; the best one counts, so make sure at least one worker integrates everything into a complete, tested ledger.py.
rubric: The spec is the contract: exact output formats, ordering, rounding, exit codes and error messages. Write your own end-to-end tests for every command and every error case before claiming completion.
